info.description: OpenAPI subset of the Fitness Tracker API for the admin panel (SPEC-011). Generated by backend/scripts/export_openapi_admin.py — do not edit by hand.
info.title: Fitness Tracker — Admin Panel API (SPEC-011)

get.description: Read the admin action journal (append-only; redacted; SPEC-011 6.12).

post.description:
Separate admin login (SPEC-011 6.1.1). Never trust the UI: backend re-checks
password, account status and admin role.
MFA-ready step: verify the challenge code and issue the admin token.

Manual payment status change is forbidden for EVERY role (SPEC-011 6.4, 11.5).
The endpoint exists only to return a documented, audited refusal.

Safe, idempotent reprocessing of a provider webhook (SPEC-011 6.10).
Same key + same body -> same result; different body -> 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.

patch.description: A published challenge changes results-affecting rules ONLY via a new version (SPEC-011 6.8).

delete.description: Soft delete only. Blocked when the exercise is used by a published program (SPEC-011 6.5).

patch.description:
Catalog changes never rewrite users' historical completions (SPEC-011 6.7):
user habits/tasks live in separate tables and are untouched here.

post.description:
MVP upload: direct content with full backend validation (MIME allowlist + magic bytes
+ size + checksum). Production swaps the transport for a pre-signed URL while keeping
the same backend confirmation/validation pipeline (SPEC-011 6.5).

delete.description: Delete blocked when referenced by published content (SPEC-011 6.5).

post.description: confirm -> sent. Resending an already-sent campaign is impossible (idempotent, no duplicates).
Mass send requires audience preview and recipient count (SPEC-011 6.7).

Atomic publication: snapshot + status + audit in ONE transaction (SPEC-011 6.6, 9.11).
Publication never modifies users' already-started workouts.
Rollback = publish a NEW version from an old snapshot (history stays intact).

Unpublish: program becomes ARCHIVED; history and audit are preserved (SPEC-011 11.3).
SUPER_ADMIN (content:force_unpublish) may bypass the approval gate.

get.description: Search by internal id, masked Telegram id, email, name, status.

post.description: Assign a role from the allowed set. ADMIN cannot grant SUPER_ADMIN (11.1).
Soft delete (+optional anonymization). Physical deletion is impossible from the UI (SPEC-011 6.3).
